subject: Request: single-invoice onboarding path for CycloneAI (no PO)
messages:
From: Sasha Li <sasha@cyclone.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 15:07:00 -0800
Subject: Onboarding: single-invoice path request

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — CycloneAI is excited about Redwood for inference cost control. We're a small procurement org and our vendor onboarding requires a PO, but as a pre-revenue startup our finance team can only commit to single-invoice payments for the first 90 days. Would Redwood consider a temporary "single-invoice" onboarding path (no PO) for the pilot?

If needed we can provide company registration docs, a short SOC-lite questionnaire, and a sample vendor W9. Attached is our onboarding intake form and a brief statement explaining our payment constraints.

Goal: get pilot running next week.

Thanks,
Sasha Li
Head of Ops, CycloneAI
attach: cyclone_company_form.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
To: Sasha Li <sasha@cyclone.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onboarding: single-invoice path request

Hi Sasha —

Appreciate the context and the quick turnaround. Short answer: we can consider a temporary single-invoice path for pilots, but it requires a documented approval and a couple of safeguards from procurement and legal. To move quickly, please confirm you can provide:

- Company registration / W9 (or equivalent)
- Point of contact for billing (name + email)
- High-level SOW or pilot description with estimated spend cap for 90 days

I'll route this to procurement for a one-off authorization. I copied Marissa (procurement) to coordinate the risk checklist. I've attached the intake checklist and we'll need a brief risk worksheet back from Cyclone.

Next steps: if you can return the three items today, I'll start the approval thread.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Vendor Onboarding Manager
Redwood Inference
attach: vendor_intake_checklist.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:42:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Onboarding: single-invoice path request (CycloneAI)

Marissa / David — forwarding a request from CycloneAI for a 90-day single-invoice onboarding (no PO). Key points: pilot spend cap estimated at $4,500, startup procurement constraints, they provided the company form (attached) and asked to start next week.

Risks/Safeguards I'm proposing for approval:
- Approval limited to 90 days and a spend cap of $5,000
- Require quarterly invoice with line items and an assigned billing contact
- Include a minimal SLA acknowledgement and data handling summary (they provided SOC-lite answers)
- Escalation clause: automatic hold if invoice > spend cap or if 2 overdue payments occur

I completed a quick risk worksheet (attached) — please review and advise whether procurement can approve administratively or if we need legal sign-off. If we can approve, I'll send Cyclone the onboarding acceptance and billing instructions.

Thanks,
Priya
attach: risk-worksheet.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 11:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Onboarding: single-invoice path request (CycloneAI)

Priya —

Thanks for the summary. I reviewed the risk worksheet and company docs. Approve administratively with the following conditions:

1) Explicit 90-day term and $5,000 hard cap (we will not process invoices above this without a PO).
2) Cyclone must provide a named billing contact and preferred invoice format (PDF with PO field blank).
3) Finance to hold payments until they've validated eat least one verifiable company registration record (e.g., public filings or third-party payroll).
4) Add a clause in the onboarding acceptance that Redwood may suspend services on overdue payments >30 days.

If Legal wants to add tighter language, route to them, but I don't think we need Exec sign-off. David — FYI for accounting. Priya, you can send the acceptance and onboarding checklist with the conditions.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Procurement
Redwood Inference

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
To: Sasha Li <sasha@cyclone.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Approved: temporary single-invoice onboarding for CycloneAI (90-day pilot)

Hi Sasha —

Good news: procurement has approved a temporary single-invoice onboarding path for CycloneAI with the following conditions (please confirm):

- Term: 90 days from first invoice date
- Spend cap: $5,000 total for the 90-day period
- Billing: provide a named billing contact and send invoices to invoices@redwood.ai (PDF preferred); leave PO field blank
- Verification: Finance will validate registration (we may request an additional document) before the first payment
- Collections: Redwood may suspend services on invoices overdue by >30 days

Please reply with the billing contact and confirm the pilot spend cap. Once we have that, I'll send the formal onboarding acceptance and a short acceptance form to sign. Attached: onboarding acceptance template and our intake checklist.

Thanks, and looking forward to getting you started next week.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Vendor Onboarding Manager
Redwood Inference
attach: onboarding-acceptance-template.pdf (application/pdf)
thread_preview: CycloneAI requests a 90-day single-invoice onboarding (no PO); procurement approves with a $5k cap and conditions.
